target_bug.title: Key of Awakening can be assembled with only two fragments
target_bug.hint: Focus on key-fragment progression. Verify whether assembling the final escape key enforces every documented prerequisite before the combine action succeeds.
target_bug.expected_behavior: Combining key fragments should require all three fragments before producing the complete Key of Awakening.
target_bug.observed_fault: The player can assemble the complete key with only two fragments instead of all three.
reproduction: Reach a state with exactly two of the three key fragments in inventory.
Observe whether the complete Key of Awakening is created before the third fragment is present.
